content:
support_jenna: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 502/504s and high tail latency for hosted inference in sa-east1. Some are also seeing intermittent auth failures. Escalating.

matt.h: seeing the same in metrics — 5xx spike starting ~4861234000, p95 latency jumped. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/metrics/sa-east1/hosted-inference :eyes:

anika: customers mention "Auth token invalid" followed by 502s. Could be retries + backend churn. Any packetloss signs?

support_jenna: reproducer from a customer: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` returns 502 then `connection reset by peer`. Paste of error: ```* Connected to api.redwood.com (34.120.45.67) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake completed
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
* Connection #0 to host api.redwood.com left intact
```

tom.network: running traceroutes from our sa-east1 egress -> provider path shows packet loss starting at peer AS 33737 (regional ISP). Also seeing BGP updates: `withdraw/announce` flapping on the peer.

matt.h: can you paste `show interfaces counters` and any tail system logs from the edge gateway?

tom.network: interface counters show packet drops on xe-0/2/1: `input errors 432, output errors 0` over the last 10m. BGP flaps correlated. Logs: ```Mar 17 14:55:12 rtr1 bgpd[2201]: neighbor 203.0.113.45: BGP NOTIFICATION sent (update unprocessed)
Mar 17 14:55:13 rtr1 kernel: RPF check failed for src 198.51.100.0/24
```

anika: that RPF msg could explain auth failure noise if SYNs are getting dropped and retries cause token expiry? Might also be our edge LB seeing partial connections and returning 502s.

sre-bot: Alert: sa-east1-gateway packet-loss > 3% for 10m; auto-failover not triggered (policy: prefer-local).

devex-eli: we have customers in Brazil hitting us; ops can we shift traffic to us-east1 failover for affected customers temporarily? Need opt-in or apply selector?

tom.network: advised immediate mitigation: 1) ask peering provider to prep route dampening, 2) enable multi-homing preference to secondary transit for sa-east1 edge, 3) temporarily raise connection retry backoff to avoid auth token churn. Implementing route preference now.

matt.h: implemented route pref to secondary transit => BGP path moved to AS 64512. Early numbers show 5xx down ~40% and p95 latency improving.

support_jenna: customer update template ready. Notifying top-10 impacted customers and offering to failover them to us-east1 with minimal config change.

anika: created short repro script to validate: ```#!/bin/bash
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://sa-east1.api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'; sleep 0.5; done``` Run before/after to show improvement.

matt.h: double-checking billing spikes — some customers retried heavily. Need to open a billing escalation for impacted accounts. tagging finance.

support_jenna: Filing tickets to support portal for affected customers with mitigation steps and credit request instructions.

tom.network: monitoring ongoing. If flaps return we'll trigger automated failover policy to route traffic away from the peering.

devex-eli: action items: (1) networks to work with provider (tom), (2) SRE to validate LB backoff and token expiry interplay (matt), (3) Support to send comms + billing ticket (jenna), (4) Postmortem owner? assigning anika.

anika: I'll own the postmortem. Collecting logs: BGP updates, interface counters, gateway LB traces, customer repro logs. Will target initial postmortem draft in 24h. :white_check_mark:

support_jenna: customers updated. One asked for immediate DNS failover — we recommended application-level retry/backoff and offered failover.

matt.h: last check @4861234588: 5xx rate back to baseline, packet loss reduced to <0.5%, latency normalized. Closing incident channel once postmortem triage done.

sre-bot: Incident cleared for sa-east1 at 4861234590 (metrics stable).
